summary: ICZOOM Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its extraordinary general meeting held August 14, 2026. Shareholders approved a 1-for-5 share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective immediately, and authorized the board to implement a further consolidation at a ratio between 1-for-2 and 1-for-10 by February 10, 2027, at the board's discretion. The meeting had a quorum with Class B shares voting 100% in favor. This is a routine share-capital restructuring to meet listing requirements, not a special situation; no premium, price, or external transaction is involved.
